+## What
+The CLI is the first real consumer of the new models. Move it before the old API is removed.
+
+- [ ] `Sources/AcpClientCore/AgentSession.swift`: hold a `ConnectionModel`; use `connect(over:logger:client:)`, `initialize`, and `newSession`; read `state` where it read `connectionState`.
+- [ ] `Sources/AcpClientCore/TurnRunner.swift`: send the prompt through `SessionModel.prompt`; read the answer text from the agent-message entries of `transcript`; detect the turn end from `agentState`.

+- [ ] No file in `Sources/AcpClientCore` names `SwiftUIACPClient` or `ACPSessionState`.
+- [ ] `acp-client run`, `probe`, and `doctor` give the same stdout, stderr and exit codes as before.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Update `Tests/FoundationModelsACPClientTests/AgentSessionTests.swift`, `TurnRunnerTests.swift`, `DecliningClientTests.swift`, `ProbeReportTests.swift` to the new models.
+- [ ] Update `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsACPClientIntegrationTests/Support/TransportTestSupport.swift`, `CLITestSupportTests.swift`, `AgentProcessTests.swift`.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes and `swift test --package-path IntegrationTests` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
